plan.scope: INSTANT TESTNET DEMO: configuration can be applied immediately by the controller, with zero notice. This contract only deploys on Monad testnet. Create a dedicated paused vault and ERC-8004 identity. Controller owns the identity and administers this vault; the declared execution key is its manager. This vault uses the six-decimal ERC-20 quote asset 0x534b2f3A21130d7a60830c2Df862319e593943A3 for deposits, valuation and redemption. Native MON investment and redemption are not implemented by this deployment. No deposit, approval, swap or token transfer. Trading and investment stay blocked until live valuation and a restricted venue are configured through an immediate demo proposal and application.
